data.name: Seduce, Breed, Conquer
data.detailed_description:
SEDUCE, BREED, CONQUER

Power isn't forged in steel alone — it's bred.

Welcome to a medieval world where honor takes second place to mischief,

where every problem has a breeding-based solution, and where the only

thing more dangerous than your enemies is your own family tree. Build

a dynasty from a single seed and watch it spiral into an empire of

warriors, dragons, and questionable life choices.

⚔️ REFLEX-DRIVEN MEDIEVAL COMBAT

Master parry timing, dodge rolls, stamina management, and weapon-physics

combos. Every duel is a dance — miss your window and you'll feel it

in your bones.

🩸 BUILD A BLOODLINE THAT WON'T STOP

Seduce women, win loyalty through gifts and questionable charm, and

raise children who grow through age stages — each developing unique

traits, skills, and personalities along the way.

🐲 DEFEAT DRAGONS. BREED THEM. RIDE THEIR OFFSPRING.

Battle wild dragons until they collapse, then breed them to claim

their eggs. Hatch new hatchlings into airborne war machines, mount

them in combat, attach baskets to carry soldiers into the sky, and

grow a new generation of fire-breathing heirs.

🗡️ BREED EVERYTHING — EVEN YOUR WEAPONS

Yes, weapons too. Hand your favorite sword to the breeding cycle and

receive a smaller, faster offspring that inherits its parent's traits.

Build a family of blades. Lose your dignity. Win wars.

🏰 LEAD ARMIES OF UP TO 15 INTO BATTLE

Command warriors, dragons, and your own descendants — a unified army

of up to 15 units under your banner. Diplomacy, bribery, dynastic

marriage, or outright war — pick your weapon. Castles don't fall by

themselves.
🗡️ HOUSE AGAINST HOUSE

Forge alliances through dynastic marriage. Betray them with steel.

Crown bastards, raise mad heirs, or burn cities with green wildfire.

In a world where every great house thinks it deserves the throne,

the only way to win is to make sure your bloodline is bigger than

theirs.

🌳 SKILL TREES THAT SHAPE YOUR DYNASTY

Develop skills across Combat, Social, Crafting, Magic, Survival, and

Leadership branches. No two playthroughs build the same heir.

🎭 A WORLD THAT REFUSES TO TAKE ITSELF SERIOUSLY

Survive royal decrees written by drunken nobles. Endure curses from

a wizard who's just tired of everyone. Read the Dynasty Newspaper as

it shamelessly gossips about your latest scandal. Medieval life as

you've never seen it.

🌍 SOLO OR ONLINE CO-OP

Build your empire alone, or jump in with up to 3 friends online for

free-for-all chaos or 2v2 conquest battles. Multiplayer isn't fair.

That's the point.

In this world, everything can be bred. Yes, everything.

data.short_description: A medieval strategy game where humor outranks honor: seduce women, breed dragons, forge legends from cold steel, and build a bloodline to conquer castles. Play solo or with 3 friends online. In this world... everything can be bred. Yes, everything.
